# Parse all notes to extract habits and values, and check consistency of habit order
import re

all_notes_parsed = []
for note in habit_notes_data:
    content = note['content']
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    title = note['title']
    date_match = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', title)
    date = date_match.group(1) if date_match else None
    
    # Parse content lines after the header
    lines = content.split('\n')
    # Skip the first line (header) and any empty lines
    habits = {}
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith('#'):
            continue
        if ':' in line:
            habit, value = line.split(':', 1)
            habits[habit.strip()] = value.strip().lower()
    all_notes_parsed.append({'date': date, 'habits': habits, 'note_id': note['note_id']})

# Check habit order consistency
first_habits = list(all_notes_parsed[0]['habits'].keys())
print("First note habits order:", first_habits)
for entry in all_notes_parsed:
    if list(entry['habits'].keys()) != first_habits:
        print(f"Note {entry['note_id']} has different order: {list(entry['habits'].keys())}")
    else:
        print(f"Note {entry['date']} order matches")

# Fetch all habit notes and parse them into structured data
import re

# habit_notes is a list of note summaries (from search_notes with tags=['habit-tracker'])
# We'll fetch full content for each note
parsed_notes = []
for note_summary in habit_notes:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_summary['note_id'], access_token=access_token)
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for 2023-05-17"
    date_str = note['title'].split('for ')[1].strip()
    # Parse content lines
    lines = note['content'].split('\n')
    # Skip header lines: first line is "# Daily Habit Tracker...", second is empty
    # Then each line is "habit: yes/no"
    habits = {}
    for line in lines[2:]:
        if ':' in line:
            habit, value = line.split(':', 1)
            habits[habit.strip()] = value.strip()
    parsed_notes.append({'date': date_str, 'habits': habits})

# Verify we have all notes
print(f"Parsed {len(parsed_notes)} notes")
print("First note:", parsed_notes[0])
print("Last note:", parsed_notes[-1])
